::: {.learning-intro}
<span class="learning-eyebrow">Tutorials · Modeling intuition · Not clinical advice</span>

<p class="learning-lead">Short, plain-language notes on antibiotic exposure, target attainment, and the bacterial biology that turns genotype into the phenotypes we simulate. A separate track holds MB(ASCP) study notes: read a lesson, then take the ten-question quiz at the end.</p>
:::

## Learning tracks

::: {.learning-tracks}

::: {.learning-track .learning-track--primary}
<span class="learning-track-label">Primary track</span>

### Antibiotic PK/PD essentials

MIC and indices, PTA/CFR, free drug, infusion mode, joint BL/BLI targets, provenance, effect site, renal strata, inoculum effect, and a CAZ-AVI style case.
:::

::: {.learning-track}
<span class="learning-track-label">Secondary track</span>

### Bacterial genetics for modelers

Chromosome versus plasmid resistance, HGT-driven MIC ecology, and short-read plasmid detection versus reconstruction for AMR genomics.
:::

::: {.learning-track .learning-track--exam}
<span class="learning-track-label">Exam track · days 1–3</span>

### MB(ASCP) foundations

Read-and-quiz notes for the molecular biology board. Chemistry, replication, and transcription are up. The questions are original study items, not ASCP questions.

- [Lesson 1 · Nucleic acid chemistry](learning/mb-01-nucleic-acid-chemistry.qmd)
- [Lesson 2 · DNA replication](learning/mb-02-dna-replication.qmd)
- [Lesson 3 · Transcription and RNA processing](learning/mb-03-transcription-rna-processing.qmd)
:::
